stem: Which instruction should the nurse give a client taking lurasidone tablets?

options.A: Take the dose with food containing at least 350 calories
options.B: Take the dose only on an empty stomach to maximize absorption
options.C: Food has no meaningful effect on lurasidone absorption
options.D: Take the medication only with clear liquids and avoid solid food

rationale: DailyMed states that lurasidone tablets should be taken with food containing at least 350 calories because administration with food substantially increases absorption. Therefore A is correct. The remaining options contradict the labeled administration instructions.
educational_objective: Teach clients to take lurasidone with at least 350 calories of food to ensure appropriate absorption.
source_organization: U.S. National Library of Medicine — DailyMed
source_document_title: LURASIDONE HYDROCHLORIDE tablets — Full Prescribing Information
source_locator: §2.3 Administration Information: take with food (at least 350 calories); food substantially increases absorption; §12.3 Clinical Pharmacology
source_claim_supported: Lurasidone tablets should be taken with at least 350 calories of food because food substantially increases absorption.

audit_findings: A directly matches current labeling. B, C, and D contradict the administration instruction. The numerical threshold is directly source-supported; no unsupported precision, second answer, cueing, or unresolved conflict remains.
